llms:
Formula Objective, not the procedure: inertia J = sum over valid points i of |x_i - c_l(i)|^2, with l(i) the nearest center (lowest center id wins ties) in f32. Each Lloyd iteration reassigns every point, then moves each center to the mean of its members, c_k = sum x_i / n_k, summed in fixed order. A center that gets no point is relocated to the points farthest from their centers. Initial centers are k-means++ (seeded) or the first k valid points; with restarts the lowest J wins.

- bound symbols: 4/4

curated formula
\begin{aligned}
\term{inertia}{J}&=\sum_i \term{distance}{\lVert x_i-c_{\ell(i)}\rVert^2},\qquad \ell(i)=\arg\min_k\lVert x_i-c_k\rVert^2\\
\term{center}{c_k}&\leftarrow\frac{\sum_{i:\,\ell(i)=k}x_i}{\term{size}{n_k}}
\end{aligned}
